description: This PHP source file defines a Smarty plugin function 'smarty_function_ext_includes' that generates HTML link tags for including CSS stylesheets related to ExtJS themes and resources in an application.

methods.name: smarty_function_ext_includes
methods.description: Generates HTML link tags to include CSS files for ExtJS themes and resources based on the current theme setting, and dynamically includes additional CSS files from the theme directory.
